translations.literal: Yi falsely promised Tai and the others to set their minds at ease, while secretly reporting the situation to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Yi falsely assured Tai and the others to calm them, while secretly reporting the situation to the court.

sentences.zh: 行吏部尚書任城王澄有疾，帝召見於凝閒堂，謂之曰：「穆泰謀為不軌，扇誘宗室。

translations.literal: Acting Director of the Masters of Writing for Officials Prince Cheng of Rencheng was ill. The emperor summoned him at Ningxian Hall and said to him: "Mu Tai plots sedition and has incited the imperial house.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Director of the Masters of Writing for Officials Prince Cheng of Rencheng was ill. The emperor summoned him at Ningxian Hall and said to him, "Mu Tai plots sedition and has incited the imperial house.

sentences.zh: 脫或必然，今遷都甫爾，北人戀舊，南北紛擾，朕洛陽不立也。

translations.literal: If it should come to pass, now that the move of the capital has only just occurred, northerners cling to the old, north and south would be in turmoil, and I could not stand firm at Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: If it should come to pass, the move of the capital having only just occurred, northerners cling to the old ways, north and south would be thrown into turmoil, and I could not hold firm at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 此國家大事，非卿不能辦。

translations.literal: This is a great affair of state; no one but you can handle it.
translations.idiomatic: This is a great affair of state; no one but you can handle it.

sentences.zh: 卿雖疾，強為我北行，審觀其勢。

translations.literal: Though you are ill, force yourself north for me and observe the situation closely.
translations.idiomatic: Though you are ill, force yourself to go north for me and observe the situation closely.

sentences.zh: 儻其微弱，直往擒之；

translations.literal: If they are weak, go straight and seize them;
translations.idiomatic: If they are weak, go straight and seize them;

sentences.zh: 若已強盛可承製發並、肆兵擊之。」

translations.literal: if they have already grown strong, you may receive an edict and mobilize the armies of Bing and Si to attack them."
translations.idiomatic: if they have already grown strong, you may receive an edict and mobilize the armies of Bing and Si to attack them."

sentences.zh: 對曰：「秦等愚惑，正由戀舊，為此計耳，非有深謀遠慮；

translations.literal: He replied: "Tai and the others are foolish and deluded — it is precisely because they cling to the old that they formed this plan; they have no deep scheming or far-reaching counsel;
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "Tai and the others are foolish and deluded. It is precisely because they cling to the old that they formed this plan; they have no deep scheming or far-reaching counsel.

sentences.zh: 臣雖駑怯，足以制之，願陛下勿憂。

translations.literal: though I am dull and timid, I am sufficient to control them; may Your Majesty not worry.
translations.idiomatic: Though I am dull and timid, I am sufficient to control them. May Your Majesty not worry.

sentences.zh: 雖有犬馬之疾，何敢辭也！」

translations.literal: Though I have an illness fit for dogs and horses, how dare I decline!"
translations.idiomatic: Though I suffer an illness fit for dogs and horses, how dare I decline!"

sentences.zh: 帝笑曰：「任城肯行，朕復何憂！」

translations.literal: The emperor smiled and said, "If Rencheng is willing to go, what more have I to worry about!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor smiled and said, "If Rencheng is willing to go, what more have I to worry about!"

sentences.zh: 遂授澄節、鉛虎、竹使符、御仗左右，仍行恆州事。

translations.literal: Thereupon he granted Cheng the baton of command, the leaden-tiger tally, bamboo envoy tallies, and the emperor's bodyguard on the left and right, and he continued to act for Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he granted Cheng the baton of command, the leaden-tiger tally, bamboo envoy tallies, and the emperor's personal guard, and Cheng continued to administer Hengzhou affairs.

sentences.zh: 行至雁門，雁門太守夜告云：「泰已引兵西就陽平。」

translations.literal: Reaching Yanmen, the Yanmen prefect reported by night: "Tai has already led troops west to join Yangping."
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Yanmen, the Yanmen prefect reported by night, "Tai has already led troops west to join Yangping."

sentences.zh: 澄遽令進發。

translations.literal: Cheng urgently ordered advance.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng urgently ordered an advance.

sentences.zh: 右丞孟斌曰：「事未可量，宜依敕召並、肆兵，然後徐進。」

translations.literal: Right Assistant Director Meng Bin said, "The affair cannot yet be measured; you should follow the edict and summon the Bing and Si troops, then advance slowly."
translations.idiomatic: Right Assistant Director Meng Bin said, "The affair cannot yet be gauged. You should follow the edict and summon the Bing and Si troops, then advance slowly."

sentences.zh: 澄曰：「泰既謀亂，應據堅城；

translations.literal: Cheng said, "Tai having plotted rebellion ought to hold a strong city;
translations.idiomatic: Cheng said, "Tai having plotted rebellion ought to hold a strong city;

sentences.zh: 而更迎陽平，度其所為，當似勢弱。

translations.literal: yet he instead goes to meet Yangping — appraising his conduct, he would seem to be in a weak position.
translations.idiomatic: yet he instead goes to meet Yangping. Judging his conduct, he would seem to be in a weak position.

sentences.zh: 泰既不相拒，無故發兵，非宜也。

translations.literal: Tai does not oppose us; to mobilize troops without cause would be improper.
translations.idiomatic: Tai does not oppose us. To mobilize troops without cause would be improper.

sentences.zh: 但速往鎮之，民心自定。」

translations.literal: Only hasten there to stabilize the situation, and the people's hearts will settle of themselves."
translations.idiomatic: Only hasten there to stabilize the situation, and popular sentiment will settle of itself."

sentences.zh: 遂倍道兼行。

translations.literal: Thereupon he doubled his pace and pressed on night and day.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he doubled his pace and pressed on by forced marches.

sentences.zh: 先遣治書侍御史李煥單騎入代，出其不意，曉諭泰黨，示以禍福，皆莫為之用。

translations.literal: He first sent Supervising Secretary Attendant Censor Li Huan alone on horseback into Dai; catching them unawares, he explained and persuaded Tai's party, showing them fortune and disaster — none would serve them.
translations.idiomatic: He first sent Supervising Secretary Attendant Censor Li Huan alone on horseback into Dai. Catching them unawares, he explained matters to Tai's party and showed them fortune and disaster — none would serve them.

sentences.zh: 泰計無所出，帥麾下數百人攻煥，不克，走出城西；

translations.literal: Tai's plans came to nothing; he led several hundred men under his command to attack Huan, failed, and fled out the west of the city;
translations.idiomatic: Tai could devise no plan. He led several hundred men under his command to attack Huan, failed, and fled out the west gate;

sentences.zh: 追擒之。

translations.literal: They pursued and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: They pursued and captured him.

sentences.zh: 澄亦尋至，窮治黨與，收陸睿等百餘人，皆繫獄，民間貼然。

translations.literal: Cheng also soon arrived, thoroughly prosecuted the co-conspirators, seized Lu Rui and more than a hundred others — all were imprisoned — and among the common people all was calm.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng also soon arrived, prosecuted the co-conspirators to the end, seized Lu Rui and more than a hundred others — all were imprisoned — and the common people were entirely calm.

sentences.zh: 澄具狀表聞，帝喜，召公卿，以表示之曰：「任城可謂社稷臣也。

translations.literal: Cheng submitted a full report in a memorial. The emperor was pleased, summoned the dukes and ministers, showed them the memorial, and said, "Rencheng may be called a minister of the altars of state.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng submitted a full report in a memorial. The emperor was pleased, summoned the dukes and ministers, showed them the memorial, and said, "Rencheng may truly be called a minister of the altars of state.

sentences.zh: 觀其獄辭，正復皋陶何以過之！」

translations.literal: Looking at his case records, even Gao Yao could not surpass him!"
translations.idiomatic: Looking at his case records, even Gao Yao could not have surpassed him!"

sentences.zh: 顧謂咸陽王禧等曰：「汝曹當此，不能辦也。」

translations.literal: He turned and said to Prince Xi of Xianyang and the others, "If you lot faced this, you could not have managed it."
translations.idiomatic: He turned and said to Prince Xi of Xianyang and the others, "If you faced this, you could not have managed it."

sentences.zh: 魏主謀入寇，引見公卿於清徽堂，曰：「朕卜宅土中，綱條粗舉；

translations.literal: The Wei ruler planned to invade the south, summoned the dukes and ministers at Qinghui Hall, and said, "I have chosen my dwelling in the central land, and regulations are roughly in place;
translations.idiomatic: The Wei ruler planned a southern invasion. He summoned the dukes and ministers at Qinghui Hall and said, "I have chosen my dwelling in the central land, and regulations are roughly in place;

sentences.zh: 唯南冠未平，安能效近世天子下惟於深宮之中乎！

translations.literal: only the southern captives are not yet pacified — how could I emulate the recent-age emperors who lowered their curtains deep within the palace!
translations.idiomatic: only the southern foe is not yet pacified — how could I emulate recent emperors who lowered their curtains deep within the palace!

sentences.zh: 朕今南征決矣，但未知早晚之期。

translations.literal: My southern campaign is now settled; I only do not know whether it will be sooner or later.
translations.idiomatic: My southern campaign is now decided; I only do not know whether it will come sooner or later.

sentences.zh: 比來術者皆雲，今往必克。

translations.literal: Recently the diviners have all said that if we go now we are sure to conquer.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the diviners have all said that if we march now we are sure to conquer.

sentences.zh: 此國之大事，宜君臣各盡所見，勿以朕先言而依違於前，同異於後也。」

translations.literal: This is a great matter of state; ruler and ministers should each offer their fullest views — do not because I spoke first be irresolute before me and at odds behind my back."
translations.idiomatic: This is a great matter of state. Ruler and ministers should each offer their fullest views — do not, because I spoke first, be irresolute to my face and at odds behind my back."

sentences.zh: 李沖對曰：「凡用兵之法，宜先論人事，後察天道。

translations.literal: Li Chong replied, "As a rule the art of using troops should first weigh human affairs and only afterward observe Heaven's will.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chong replied, "As a rule, the art of war should first weigh human affairs and only afterward observe Heaven's will.

sentences.zh: 今卜筮雖吉而人事未備，遷都尚新，秋谷不稔，未可以興師旅。

translations.literal: Now though divination and milfoil are auspicious, human affairs are not yet ready: the move of the capital is still recent, the autumn grain has not ripened well — one cannot yet raise armies.
translations.idiomatic: Now though divination and milfoil are auspicious, human affairs are not yet ready. The move of the capital is still recent, the autumn grain has not ripened well — armies cannot yet be raised.

sentences.zh: 如臣所見，宜俟來秋。」

translations.literal: As I see it, we should wait until next autumn."
translations.idiomatic: As I see it, we should wait until next autumn."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「去十七年，朕擁兵二十萬，此人事之盛也，而天時不利。

translations.literal: The emperor said, "Seventeen years ago I held two hundred thousand troops — that was the height of human strength — yet Heaven's season was unfavorable.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Seventeen years ago I held two hundred thousand troops — that was the height of human strength — yet Heaven's season was unfavorable.

sentences.zh: 今天時既從，復去人事未備，如僕射之言，是終無征伐之期也。

translations.literal: Now Heaven's season has complied, yet again to cast aside unprepared human affairs, as the Vice Director says — that would mean there is no end to the time for campaigning.
translations.idiomatic: Now Heaven's season has complied, yet again to set aside unprepared human affairs, as the Vice Director says — that would mean there is never a time for campaigning.

sentences.zh: 寇戎咫尺，異日將為社稷之憂，朕何敢自安！

translations.literal: The enemy raiders are at our doorstep; someday they will be a worry for the altars of state — how dare I rest secure!
translations.idiomatic: The enemy raiders are at our doorstep. Someday they will be a calamity for the altars of state — how dare I rest secure!

sentences.zh: 若秋行不捷，諸君當盡付司寇，不可不盡懷也。」

translations.literal: If the autumn campaign is not victorious, you gentlemen should all be handed over to the Minister of Justice — you must not fail to give your utmost thought to this."
translations.idiomatic: If the autumn campaign is not victorious, you gentlemen should all be handed over to the Minister of Justice — you must not fail to give this your utmost thought."

sentences.zh: 魏主以有罪徙邊者多逋亡，乃制一人逋亡，闔門充役。

translations.literal: Because many exiled to the frontier for crimes fled, the Wei ruler ordained that if one person fled, the whole household would be conscripted for labor service.
translations.idiomatic: Because many criminals exiled to the frontier fled, the Wei ruler ordained that if one person fled, the entire household would be conscripted for labor service.

sentences.zh: 光州刺史博陵崔挺上書諫曰：「天下善人少，惡人多。

translations.literal: Guangzhou Inspector Cui Ting of Boling submitted a memorial remonstrating: "Under Heaven good men are few and evil men many.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzhou Inspector Cui Ting of Boling submitted a memorial of remonstrance: "Under Heaven, good men are few and evil men many.

sentences.zh: 若一人有罪，延及闔門，則司馬牛受桓魋之罰，柳下惠嬰盜跖之誅，豈不哀哉！」

translations.literal: If one man is guilty and it extends to the whole household, then Sima Niu would suffer Huan Tui's punishment and Liuxia Hui would bear the execution due to Robber Zhi — is that not pitiable!"
translations.idiomatic: If one man is guilty and punishment extends to the whole household, then Sima Niu would suffer Huan Tui's punishment and Liuxia Hui would bear the execution due to Robber Zhi — is that not pitiable!"

sentences.zh: 帝善之，遂除其制。

translations.literal: The emperor approved it and thereupon abolished the regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the memorial and thereupon abolished the regulation.
